records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase in revenue was primarily driven by higher volume in OFSE.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In 2022, we had a record year for LNG equipment orders, and achieved significant growth in new energy orders compared to 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our performance improved over the second half of 2022 as supply chain challenges moderated, we saw increased activity primarily in OFSE, and we were able to achieve price improvements that collectively more than offset these operational challenges.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Baker Hughes was successful in 2022, with key commercial successes and solid margin improvements in OFSE.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income in 2022 was $1,185 million compared to $1,310 million in 2021.
